text:
Samir Patel: Hey all, first day! SSO works but I get 403 on GCP project `redwood-eu-staging` and AWS console shows "Access Denied" for Billing. I need to run tests in `eu-west1` and `eu-central1`. Who should I ping for role grants?
Erin Walsh: welcome Samir :tada: For GCP you usually need: billing access (`roles/billing.user`) on the billing account and project-level deploy roles. For our infra we give `roles/run.admin` + `roles/storage.objectViewer` for Cloud Run deploys.
Samir Patel: thanks. Do I need org-level permissions?
Erin Walsh: not for dev. Org perms are restricted. We add people to the `redwood-devs` IAM group on projects and grant billing via the billing account. For AWS, we add you to the `redwood-devs` IAM group in the org which maps to cross-account roles for non-prod. That group has `BillingReadOnlyAccess` attached.
Maya Chen: also FYI our AWS billing console requires MFA on first login. If you haven't set up `aws-mfa` you'll see Access Denied until you finish that step.
Samir Patel: I'm able to set up MFA. What info do you need to request the grants?
Erin Walsh: Send your full name and `samir.patel@redwood.com`, list of projects (or say `all dev projects`) and which regions. If you want SA creation mention it (we restrict SA creation in eu regions). Example payload we paste in the ticket: `Name: Samir Patel
Email: samir.patel@redwood.com
Projects: redwood-eu-staging, redwood-eu-infra
Regions: eu-west1, eu-central1
BillingAccount: BILL-9f8e7d6c5b
Reason: run infra smoke tests and deploy tiny service for onboarding.`
onboarding-bot: Ticket INC-4902 created and assigned to `cloud-ops` (Erin Walsh). ETA 1 business day. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4902
Erin Walsh: I'll start the GCP side. In the meantime you can check whether your SSO identity is visible with: `gcloud auth list` and for AWS: `aws sts get-caller-identity`. Paste outputs if you hit funny 403s.
Samir Patel: `gcloud auth list` shows my account as active. `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns a principal but console still 403 on Billing.
Maya Chen: console 403 + sts ok usually means you need the console permission (`aws-portal:ViewBilling`) which the `BillingReadOnlyAccess` policy doesn't always include for org setups. We'll assign the billing policy directly to your IAM user via the dev group.
Erin Walsh: Done for GCP: granted `roles/billing.user` on billing account and added temporary `roles/run.admin` on `redwood-eu-staging`. For AWS I added you to `redwood-devs` group and attached `arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/Billing` to the group. Give it ~10 min to propagate.
Samir Patel: tried `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-staging` and I can read it now. AWS Billing console access still 403.
Maya Chen: try logging out and back in, and ensure you used the SSO link rather than root account. Also check the console region picker sometimes blocks.
Samir Patel: logging out/in worked. I can see billing now. Trying a Cloud Run deploy test: `gcloud run deploy test-onboard --image=gcr.io/redwood-dev/test:latest --region=eu-west1`
Erin Walsh: If that fails with SA creation error, add `--service-account` with the team SA or ask for SA creation in the ticket. Remember org policy blocks unmanaged SA creation in eu.
Samir Patel: got `Permission denied: serviceAccount.actor` when trying to use team SA.
Erin Walsh: I added you to the allowed members for the team SA. Try again.
Samir Patel: deploy succeeded! Thanks all.
onboarding-bot: INC-4902 updated: cloud-ops completed initial grants; will convert temp role to group membership and close when confirmed.
Erin Walsh: I'll annotate the ticket with commands we ran and close once group membership is confirmed tomorrow. Welcome aboard Samir, happy to pair on the first deploy.
Samir Patel: really appreciate it :heart: excited to be here!
Ops Bot: Reminder: set up your cost alerts dashboard (link: https://console.redwood/costs) and enable 2FA for AWS if not already done.
